articles.summary: Viral Social Media Creator "MD Motivator" Surprises Cincinnati Student with Full-Ride Nursing Scholarship to Chamberlain University Chamberlain and Covista Commit $150,000 to Expand Healthcare Career Pathways for Cincinnati Youth Chamberlain University, the nation's largest school of nursing and a Covista institution, cut the ribbon today on its 25th campus nationwide, bringing a new source of nurses to Cincinnati as the first cohort of students prepares to begin classes Aug. 31. The institution marked the occasion with another first: awarding its inaugural Future Healthcare Hero BSN Scholarship, covering the full cost of a Cincinnati resident’s Chamberlain University nursing degree. Chamberlain University President Amelia Manning is joined by Executive Campus Director Priya Shastri, future Chamberlain student Damenika Jacobs, Chamberlain alumna Rachell Dumas, Ohio state Rep. articles.title: Chamberlain University Opens 25th Campus Nationwide, Bringing New Nursing Talent Pipeline to Cincinnati

articles.summary: Scott Liles Expands Remit to Lead Corporate Strategy and New Performance Acceleration Office Rick Sinkfield Joins as Vice President of Expansion Covista (NYSE: CVSA), America's largest healthcare educator, today announced an expanded leadership role for Scott Liles and the addition of Rick Sinkfield as Vice President of Expansion, both in support of the company's three-year Purpose at Scale growth strategy built around four core principles: operational excellence, platform extension, employer integration and technology focus. "These moves strengthen our ability to execute our growth strategy in the marketplace," said Steve Beard, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Covista. "Scott and Rick bring the integrated, enterprise-wide thinking and discipline to carry Purpose at Scale forward. Continuing to build our leadership bench now is how we ensure our growth ambitions and our execution stay in lockstep to deliver on our purpose: to open doors and unlock potential." Scott Liles Named
articles.title: Covista Expands and Strengthens Leadership Bench to Accelerate Purpose at Scale
